The U-shaped neckline and backless design is secured via two integrated cords, each adorned with a shiny silver stud and an eyelet, respectively. name: CARLOS CASTANET COIN PURSE
body_html: This coin purse stems from an ongoing dialogue between artist Carlos Peñafiel and LEMAIRE. Entirely hand-molded, this limited edition 'castanets' shape emerges as the smooth patina leather is worked over a solid mold. This sculptural purse with organic curves embodies LEMAIRE’s ongoing dialogue between form and function. Produced in limited editions, each piece is shaped through an artisanal process. This meticulous approach lends subtle variations in shape and colour, making every creation uniquely its own. Due to the nature of vegetable-tanned leather and its entirely handcrafted production, slight irregularities or natural marks may be visible. These are part of the authenticity of the material and craftsmanship, contributing to the unique character of each piece.
